input.subject: [E1] PS5 Delivery Before Sep 1
input.body: Dear Customer Support, I would like to know the expected delivery date for my PS5 order. Is it possible to have it delivered before September 1st? It is a birthday gift for my friend, so I would really appreciate delivery before that date if possible. Please let me know the expected delivery date and whether expedited delivery is available. Thank you.
